name: Assign money to categories
description: Assign Ready to Assign dollars to categories until all available money has a job.
user_problem: Unplanned cash is hard to prioritize.
benefit: Assignments make each dollar's purpose visible.
uncertainty: Manual assignment and optional Auto-Assign are both supported.

name: Negative Ready to Assign
description: Negative Ready to Assign means overassignment; future months can be negative while the current month is zero.
user_problem: Overassignment can make future plans impossible to fund.
benefit: The warning identifies where assignments must be reduced.
uncertainty: Help documents symptoms and fixes, not the full formula.

name: Positive category rollover
description: Positive category Available amounts remain in the category when the calendar month changes.
user_problem: Users want unused funds to remain for their planned purpose.
benefit: Saved category balances carry forward automatically.
uncertainty: Applies at calendar-month rollover.

name: Reset monthly assignments
description: At rollover Assigned generally resets to zero while positive Available remains.
user_problem: Users need to distinguish this month's assignments from prior saved funds.
benefit: The new month starts a fresh assignment period with retained balances.
uncertainty: Future-month assignments can affect the displayed result.

name: Cash overspending rollover
description: Uncovered cash overspending resets the category to zero and reduces next month's Ready to Assign.
user_problem: Cash overspending has consumed money elsewhere in the plan.
benefit: The next month reflects the cash shortage without a negative category carry.
uncertainty: Support recommends covering it in the month incurred.

name: Credit overspending rollover
description: Uncovered card overspending resets the category to zero and appears as an Underfunded alert in the card payment category.
user_problem: Unfunded card purchases create debt without cash reserved for payment.
benefit: The payment category surfaces the debt shortfall.
uncertainty: Card debt persists; the category deficit does not.

name: Ready to Assign rollover
description: Unassigned money carries if there was no cash overspending; cash overspending is deducted before the remainder carries.
user_problem: Users need to know how unassigned funds and past deficits affect the new month.
benefit: Rollover reflects money still available to plan.
uncertainty: Web app exposes a detailed breakdown.

name: Separate cash and credit overspending
description: Cash deficits appear red and credit deficits yellow; with both, red may show until cash overspending is covered, then yellow may remain.
user_problem: One negative category can have different funding consequences.
benefit: Color and details help identify cash shortfall versus new debt.
source_locator: Effects of Credit Card Overspending and How to Find It
uncertainty: No general mixed-spend allocation formula is published.

name: Move funded card spending to payment reserve
description: A card purchase funded by its spending category automatically moves the funded amount to that card's payment category.
user_problem: Category spending reduces cash that should be reserved for card payment.
benefit: Users can see purchase cash set aside for a future bill.
uncertainty: Movement is limited by category Available.

name: Unfunded card purchase treatment
description: Card spending above category Available increases card debt without increasing payment-category Available; covering current overspending moves funds to payment reserve.
user_problem: Borrowed spending can leave a future bill underfunded.
benefit: The plan distinguishes debt from cash reserved for repayment.
source_locator: An Overview; How and When to Cover
uncertainty: Prior-month deficits require direct payment-category funding.

name: Paired Credit Card Payment category
description: Adding a card creates a paired payment category; its Available amount represents cash reserved from funded spending and direct assignments.
user_problem: Users need a plan-side amount for what can be paid.
benefit: The reserved payment amount is visible beside spending categories.
uncertainty: Past overspending, fees, rewards, or adjustments may create a mismatch.

name: Fund existing card debt
description: A card balance from before plan setup needs direct assignment to its payment category.
user_problem: There are no in-plan purchases to fund the starting debt.
benefit: Direct assignment creates an explicit payoff plan.
uncertainty: Assigned amount depends on intended payoff.

name: Record payment to card
description: A payment from a cash account is recorded as a transfer to the card, reducing its balance and drawing on payment-category funds.
user_problem: A payment must change both account balances without becoming category spending.
benefit: Transfer treatment preserves the payment reserve and cash ledger.
uncertainty: External-account payments have separate handling.

name: Payment reserve versus owed balance
description: For a paid-in-full card, payment-category Available should match the amount owed; for carried debt it should match the intended payment.
user_problem: Users may otherwise send more than reserved or carry unplanned debt.
benefit: The comparison shows if cash is ready for the next payment.
uncertainty: Target differs when paying down debt over time.

name: Categorize card refund to spending
description: A card refund categorized to the original spending category reverses the purchase's category-to-payment movement.
user_problem: A refund should restore the plan category affected by the purchase.
benefit: Returned funds become available for the original purpose.
source_locator: Why categorize back to a spending category
uncertainty: Users can move restored funds elsewhere later.

name: Classify refunds and reimbursements
description: An inflow offsetting a recorded expense goes to its original category; a new inflow goes to Ready to Assign.
user_problem: Inflow categorization can distort income and spending totals.
benefit: The rule preserves meaningful income and net-spending views.
uncertainty: Card refunds specifically go to the original category.

name: Statement credit and cash reward treatment
description: A statement credit reduces card debt without increasing payment-category funds; a cash reward deposited to checking is a separate inflow.
user_problem: Rewards can change debt without changing cash reserved for the bill.
benefit: Different reward destinations have understandable account and plan effects.
uncertainty: A reward creating positive card balance follows positive-balance rules.

name: Positive card balance behaves like cash
description: A positive card balance adds money to the plan; automatic payment-category movement pauses and overspending is treated as cash until the card is negative again.
user_problem: Overpayments and refunds can make normal credit-card rules misleading.
benefit: The plan avoids reserving repayment cash when the card is owed money.
source_locator: What Happens When a Credit Card Balance is Positive
uncertainty: Overpayment and categorized refunds can affect different plan locations.

name: Credit card cash advance
description: A card-to-cash transfer increases card debt, increases cash, and raises Ready to Assign.
user_problem: Cash advances create debt while placing cash into a budget account.
benefit: Cash is available to plan while the card liability remains visible.
uncertainty: Payment category does not automatically reserve repayment funds.

name: Weekly target cadence
description: Weekly targets compute the month's total from the selected week-start day and how often that day occurs in the month.
user_problem: Weekly expenses vary with the number of occurrences in a month.
benefit: The goal reflects a calendar-aware weekly amount.
uncertainty: No native biweekly target; workarounds can overfund five-week months.

name: Monthly target behavior
description: Monthly targets repeat on calendar boundaries; Set Aside Another requests the full amount, while Refill Up To requests what was spent or removed.
user_problem: Users need targets for accumulation or capped monthly spending.
benefit: Behavior matches whether funds should build up or refill to a cap.
uncertainty: Set Aside Another tracks assignment, not spending.

name: Yearly target behavior
description: Yearly targets use a chosen By date, allow an initial shorter saving period, then repeat annually.
user_problem: Irregular annual costs need a predictable monthly saving amount.
benefit: Users can prepare for known yearly expenses.
uncertainty: Set Aside Another does not reduce the next target based on spending.

name: Custom set-aside target
description: A custom target requests a total by a due date and can be one-time or repeat monthly/yearly.
user_problem: Nonstandard and one-time expenses do not fit a simple monthly goal.
benefit: Users can pace assignments toward a specific date.
uncertainty: Repeat cadence is documented as monthly or yearly.

name: Custom refill target
description: Fill Up To counts category Available toward the goal and requests the remaining gap by the due date.
user_problem: A spending cap should count funds left from earlier periods.
benefit: Users assign only enough to restore the category to its target.
source_locator: Custom Targets; Fill up to behavior
uncertainty: Future-month calculations may request the full amount until that month begins.

name: Custom balance target
description: Have a Balance Of asks for a target Available balance by a date; it does not repeat and is not intended for spending before due.
user_problem: Large one-time balances need a clear accumulation goal.
benefit: Users can track progress toward a desired saved amount.
source_locator: Custom Targets; Have a balance of behavior
uncertainty: No-due-date targets are omitted from Underfunded Auto-Assign.

name: Conservative future refill target
description: In a future month, Refill Up To may request the full amount because current-month spending could reduce rollover before the target month starts.
user_problem: Future category money can still be spent before the target period.
benefit: Projection avoids treating unsecured rollover as guaranteed.
source_locator: FAQ: Refill up to target in next month
uncertainty: Behavior changes when the month becomes current.

name: Underfunded Auto-Assign priority
description: Underfunded uses Ready to Assign to cover overspending, targets, scheduled transactions, and card payment needs in priority order.
user_problem: Prioritizing many due needs manually takes time.
benefit: Users can quickly fund the most urgent plan needs.
uncertainty: Categories without targets, schedules, or alerts may be excluded.

name: Auto-Assign due-date order
description: Underfunded prioritizes overspending, dated transactions and targets, end-of-month targets, later targets, then card payment needs.
user_problem: Arbitrary assignment order can leave near-term bills unfunded.
benefit: Due-date order helps reserve funds for nearer needs.
uncertainty: Multiple schedules in one category are funded as a monthly total, not by individual dates.

name: Scoped Auto-Assign preview
description: With no selection Auto-Assign affects the whole plan except hidden categories; selection scopes it. Users can preview and adjust before saving.
user_problem: Bulk assignment can affect unintended categories.
benefit: Scope and preview make the action reviewable.
source_locator: What to Expect; How to Auto-Assign
uncertainty: Preview requires positive Ready to Assign.

name: History-based Auto-Assign
description: Options include last month's assigned/spent and rolling averages of assigned/spent over up to 12 prior months.
user_problem: Variable expenses need a starting assignment estimate.
benefit: Past behavior can seed a plan quickly.
uncertainty: Current month excluded; Average Assigned starts at first assignment.

name: Reduce category overfunding
description: Auto-Assign can return money above target and scheduled needs to Ready to Assign.
user_problem: Categories may hold more than current planned needs.
benefit: Excess funds are available to reprioritize.
uncertainty: Appears only when overfunding exists.

name: Scheduled transactions as plan needs
description: Upcoming schedules appear in account registers and contribute to category underfunded indicators and Auto-Assign.
user_problem: Future bills can be forgotten when assigning funds.
benefit: Plan reflects known upcoming outflows.
uncertainty: Users still review and enter transactions.

name: Enter scheduled occurrence early
description: Enter Now records one scheduled transaction today while keeping later occurrences on the original schedule.
user_problem: A bill may arrive earlier than expected.
benefit: Users record it without shifting recurrence.
source_locator: How to Enter a Future Transaction Now
uncertainty: Only that occurrence is dated today.

name: Edit recurring schedule future
description: Editing the next scheduled occurrence changes future instances but not posted history; editing a past transaction leaves the series intact.
user_problem: Changed bills should not rewrite history.
benefit: Future plans can change while preserving recorded transactions.
uncertainty: Deleting the schedule removes upcoming instances.

name: Scheduled day 31 adjustment
description: A transaction scheduled on the 31st repeats on the final day of shorter months.
user_problem: Some months do not have a 31st day.
benefit: Month-end bills stay scheduled each month.
uncertainty: Other recurrence calendar rules are not fully detailed in the retrieved page.

name: Loan account paired category
description: Pairing a category with a loan adds balance, minimum payment, payoff date, Record Payment, and Monthly Debt Payment target tools.
user_problem: Debt details otherwise sit apart from the monthly cash plan.
benefit: A category connects planned payments with payoff information.
uncertainty: Features apply to YNAB Loan account type.

name: Loan payment and payoff target
description: Loan payments transfer cash to the loan; a paired target can set monthly amount or desired payoff date.
user_problem: Users need to connect cash outflow with liability reduction.
benefit: Plan can project payment and payoff date.
uncertainty: Projection depends on entered balance and terms.

name: Loan interest estimate
description: Monthly interest is annual rate divided by 12 times current balance; it is applied to the first monthly payment before principal.
user_problem: Payment allocation between interest and principal is hard to estimate manually.
benefit: Loan account shows an amortization-style breakdown and payoff estimate.
source_locator: How Does YNAB Calculate; How Is Interest Applied
uncertainty: First month defaults to zero absent a payment; lender rules may differ and interest is editable.

name: Reconcile cleared balances
description: Reconciliation compares cleared balances excluding uncleared transactions; reconciled entries receive locks.
user_problem: Pending transactions make working balance unreliable for comparison.
benefit: Users get a verification point and protection from accidental edits.
uncertainty: Loan accounts use a different balance-update process.

name: Reconciliation adjustment and lock
description: When cleared balances differ users can create an adjustment; reconciled transactions cannot normally be unreconciled.
user_problem: Mismatch can remain after reviewing transactions.
benefit: Account can match verified balance and reconciled entries stay protected.
source_locator: Reconciliation steps; Can I unreconcile a transaction?
uncertainty: Adjustments affect plan cash except negative-balance card adjustments. Secondary reference: https://support.ynab.com/en_us/can-i-unreconcile-a-transaction-SJ0NquLye

name: Budget versus tracking accounts
description: Plans distinguish accounts whose activity is categorized from tracking accounts that hold a balance only.
user_problem: Users need to separate spending money from assets and liabilities tracked for context.
benefit: Account scope clarifies whether transactions affect the plan.
uncertainty: Endpoint overview does not enumerate every account type or lifecycle constraint.

name: Account register
description: Register guidance separates working balances from cleared balances and lets users inspect individual transactions.
user_problem: A single balance can obscure uncleared items and prevent bank comparison.
benefit: Register balances and transaction details support timely review.
source_locator: Finding Your Cleared Balance to Reconcile; cleared balance
uncertainty: Full register behavior and endpoint pagination were not reviewed.

name: Manual transaction entry
description: Manual entries include account, date, payee, category, inflow or outflow, memo, flag, cleared status, and optional schedule.
user_problem: Waiting for a bank feed can leave recent spending absent.
benefit: Recording transactions as they happen keeps the register current.
source_locator: How to Add a Transaction; Scheduled Transactions
uncertainty: Help notes mobile UI differences, including a staged Android update.

name: Split transactions
description: One register transaction can assign its amount to multiple categories; API transactions represent splits with subtransactions.
user_problem: A receipt covering several kinds of spending does not fit one category.
benefit: Splits retain one bank transaction while allocating its spending across categories.
uncertainty: File-based import does not create splits; rounding rules were not reviewed.

name: Account transfers
description: Transfers use special payees linked to the destination account and represent movement between account registers.
user_problem: Treating an own-account movement as income or spending distorts totals.
benefit: Linked transfer records preserve the relationship between both accounts.
uncertainty: Cross-currency transfers use separate plans; exception behavior was not reviewed.

name: Payees
description: The API supports listing, creating, and renaming payees; transfer payees identify another account.
user_problem: Inconsistent payee names make it harder to review recurring activity.
benefit: Reusable payees give transaction history a consistent name.
uncertainty: Merge semantics and restrictions are not established by the API overview.

name: Batch transaction API writes
description: The API lists collection-level POST and PATCH transaction operations alongside individual transaction operations.
user_problem: Integrations need a way to create or update several entries without one request per row.
benefit: Collection writes allow integrations to submit multiple transaction changes.
source_locator: Transactions; POST and PATCH collection endpoints
uncertainty: Batch limits, atomicity, and partial-failure behavior need endpoint schema review.

name: Flags and memos
description: Transactions support flags and memo text; search can find flag names or colors and memos.
user_problem: Users may need to remember why a purchase happened or find it later.
benefit: Flags and searchable notes add review context without changing the amount.
uncertainty: Flag customization details were outside the reviewed sections.

name: Transaction cleared states
description: Users can distinguish cleared, uncleared, and reconciled transactions; cleared balance excludes uncleared entries.
user_problem: The register total may not match the bank when pending items are mixed into the comparison.
benefit: Status-aware balances make the reconciliation comparison meaningful.
source_locator: Pending or Uncleared Transactions; Checking for Duplicate Transactions
uncertainty: The viewed API overview did not expose the status enum schema.

name: Reconciliation
description: Users compare the cleared balance in the register with the bank's cleared balance; after reconciliation, imports reach back at most three days.
user_problem: Duplicate or missing transactions can make account balances diverge.
benefit: Frequent reconciliation confirms the account and limits duplicate backfills.
uncertainty: Detailed reconciliation lock persistence and adjustment rules were not reviewed.

name: Balance adjustment
description: A balance adjustment can bring the register to the current cleared balance when the mismatch cannot be resolved from individual entries.
user_problem: Unexplained differences can prevent a user from moving on with account review.
benefit: An explicit adjustment restores the account balance while marking the discrepancy.
uncertainty: Report treatment and audit/undo behavior were not covered in the article reviewed.

name: Manual and imported transaction matching
description: A later bank import can match a manually entered item when amounts match exactly and dates are within ten days; users can also match manually.
user_problem: Manual capture followed by a bank feed can otherwise create duplicate-looking rows.
benefit: Matching retains one logical transaction when the later bank record arrives.
source_locator: How to Import Transactions; matching manually entered transactions
uncertainty: Payee, memo, split, and cleared-status matching criteria are not specified here.

name: Duplicate import suppression
description: File or direct imports may skip an identical date-and-amount item; deleted imported transactions cannot be imported into that account again.
user_problem: Repeated downloads or changed bank feeds can duplicate entries.
benefit: Duplicate checks and reconciliation reduce repeated review and incorrect balances.
source_locator: How to Handle Duplicate or Skipped Transactions
uncertainty: Rules differ across import routes; exact API import idempotency was not checked.

name: Direct bank import
description: Optional linked accounts receive recent transactions and balances, commonly within 24 to 72 hours after posting; connection failures can delay or stop updates.
user_problem: Manual upkeep is time-consuming and bank feeds can fail silently or late.
benefit: A bank connection reduces routine entry while surfacing problems for follow-up.
source_locator: What Is Direct Import; Reliability and Limitations
uncertainty: Refresh frequency varies by institution and provider.

name: Starting balance on link
description: Linking an account creates a Starting Balance transaction as of that day; earlier-cleared transactions are not imported.
user_problem: A linked register needs a baseline without replaying all prior bank history.
benefit: The balance starts from the linked account's current value.
uncertainty: Historical backfill configuration was not described.

name: Imported transaction review
description: Imported entries that need action appear in a review banner; users can approve, reject, categorize, or match them.
user_problem: Bank-provided rows may need owner review before they are treated as complete.
benefit: A focused queue makes incoming transactions easier to process.
source_locator: How to Import Transactions; review and approve
uncertainty: Exact effects of rejection and approval across all status combinations need further review.

name: File-based import formats
description: The web app accepts CSV, QFX, OFX, and QIF; iPad can use a desktop-mode drag-and-drop flow. Phone and Android apps do not support file-based import.
user_problem: A user may need an import path when bank linking is unavailable.
benefit: Downloaded bank files provide an alternative to linked feeds.
source_locator: Choosing the Right File Format; How to Import a File
uncertainty: Supported file variants and size limits were not specified.

name: File import mapping and limits
description: CSV import lets users map fields, handle missing headers, swap inflow/outflow, and include or exclude earlier entries; YNAB recommends avoiding imports over one year old.
user_problem: Bank files vary in columns, signs, and date ranges.
benefit: Import preview options adapt common file differences without editing the source file.
source_locator: Customize Your Imported CSV File; FAQs
uncertainty: The article does not state row-count or upload-size limits.

name: Transaction search and filters
description: Search covers amount, payee, category, web dates, flags, memos, split status, cleared/reconciled status, matched state, approval state, and inflow/outflow.
user_problem: Finding a transaction across a long register takes time.
benefit: Search and filters narrow the register to relevant items.
uncertainty: Exact query grammar and maximum results were not reviewed.

name: Bulk transaction actions
description: Web selection supports actions across multiple entries; the memo guide documents applying one memo to a selected group, and imported items can be reviewed in bulk.
user_problem: Repeated edits or approvals are slow when applied one transaction at a time.
benefit: Group actions reduce repetitive register work.
source_locator: How to Add Memos to Multiple Transactions
uncertainty: The full list of bulk operations and maximum selection size were not established.

name: Scheduled transactions
description: Scheduled entries represent future or recurring account transactions and include frequency, first date, and next date in the API model.
user_problem: Recurring bills and income are easy to forget or mistime.
benefit: Schedules reduce repeated entry and provide advance reminders.
source_locator: Scheduled Transactions; recurrence fields and CRUD operations
uncertainty: Calendar and recurrence edge rules were not reviewed.

name: Full plan data export
description: Web export downloads separate plan/category and transaction files; targets and category notes are excluded.
user_problem: Users need a portable copy of plan structure and transaction history.
benefit: Structured files can be reviewed in spreadsheet software.
source_locator: Exporting a Plan and All Transactions
uncertainty: The article says export is web-only.

name: Selected transaction export
description: Users can search and filter register entries, select a subset, and export those transactions as CSV or TSV.
user_problem: A user may need only a relevant subset for analysis or sharing.
benefit: Filtered export limits unnecessary data sharing and spreadsheet cleanup.
uncertainty: Photos are not included in bulk exports.

name: Reflection report export
description: Web reports export Net Worth and Income v Expense; Spending Trends and Breakdown export transaction data in separate files.
user_problem: Users may need a portable copy of report results.
benefit: Export preserves selected report periods and filters for external review.
uncertainty: Export is web-only and output varies by selected filters.

name: Net worth report
description: Net Worth reflects selected accounts over a chosen date range; web export can include monthly account-level asset and debt balances.
user_problem: Budgeting transactions alone do not show the household's balance-sheet trend.
benefit: A historical net-worth view connects account balances across time.
source_locator: Customize Net Worth; Want Even More Detail
uncertainty: Valuation dates, defaults, and account-type inclusion rules need fuller review.

name: Income and spending report
description: Income v Expense separates income and spending; own-plan transfers and credit-card payments are not counted as spending, while some tracking transfers are.
user_problem: Transfers and card payments can be mistaken for new income or expenses.
benefit: Report inclusion rules avoid common double counts.
source_locator: What's Included; Net Income and Net Worth
uncertainty: Treatment depends on account type and transaction category.

name: Spending trend drill-down
description: Users can drill from category group to category to transaction; only certain cash/credit transfers to tracking accounts are included as tracking activity.
user_problem: A headline trend does not explain which categories or purchases drove it.
benefit: Linked drill-down connects summaries to register entries.
source_locator: Spending Trends Basics; Reflect on Spending Categories
uncertainty: Payee drill-down is not available in this report.

name: Age of Money
description: Age of Money uses the last ten outflow cash transactions; transfers and starting balances do not count, and fewer than ten qualifying outflows means no figure.
user_problem: A user wants an indicator of how long cash tends to remain before spending.
benefit: The metric provides a trend about cash spending and paycheck timing.
source_locator: Reflecting on Your Age of Money; Why Isn't My Age of Money Going Up
uncertainty: API exposes a monthly value; exact calculation implementation is not published here.

name: REST API resource model
description: API organizes plans with accounts, categories, payees, months, transactions, money movements, and scheduled transactions; many reads are available at collection and item scope.
user_problem: An integration needs to know which objects and endpoints are available.
benefit: A consistent REST model supports account-level and month-specific retrieval.
source_locator: Plans; Accounts; Categories; Payees; Months; Money Movements; Transactions
uncertainty: The API describes itself as mostly read-only; write coverage varies by resource.

name: Transaction API operations
description: API lists transaction create, patch, update, delete, import, and scoped transaction reads; splits use subtransactions and transfers use transfer payees.
user_problem: External tools may need to sync, create, or correct register entries.
benefit: Multiple read/write paths enable integrations and transaction workflows.
source_locator: Transactions; POST/PATCH/import/PUT/DELETE and scoped GET endpoints
uncertainty: Exact import duplicate behavior and idempotency guarantees need endpoint review.

name: Delta synchronization
description: Supported collection resources return server knowledge that can be sent back to fetch only changed entities; YNAB recommends this to reduce traffic and processing.
user_problem: Repeated full downloads waste requests and processing time.
benefit: Delta reads make synchronization more efficient.
uncertainty: Single-resource and all filtered endpoints do not necessarily support deltas.

name: API rate limits
description: Each access token may make 200 requests in a rolling hour; exceeded usage returns HTTP 429.
user_problem: An integration can stop working if it sends requests too quickly.
benefit: Known limits support request budgeting and retry handling.
uncertainty: Limits may change; 429 no longer includes X-Rate-Limit header per changelog.

name: API amount scale
description: API amounts use milliunits, with 1,000 milliunits per currency unit; newer currency and formatted fields supplement the integer values.
user_problem: Budget stores integer cents and needs an exact conversion policy.
benefit: Explicit scale information prevents unit errors during integration.
uncertainty: Precision note: cents map exactly only when milliunits are divisible by 10; other values are sub-cent and require an explicit reject/round policy.

name: API errors and timeouts
description: Responses use a data wrapper for success and an error object for failures; 429 signals rate limiting, while 503 can indicate outages or requests taking over 30 seconds.
user_problem: Clients need to distinguish invalid requests, throttling, and service failures.
benefit: Structured errors support visible recovery and safe retry decisions.
uncertainty: Retry timing is unspecified beyond waiting and trying again.

name: Currency model
description: YNAB recommends separate plans per currency and accounts within each plan in the same currency; inter-plan currency transfers are recorded manually with rate and fees.
user_problem: A single plan-wide amount cannot be compared meaningfully across different currencies without conversion.
benefit: Separate plans avoid implicit exchange-rate calculations inside plan totals.
source_locator: Separate Plan for Each Currency; How to Use a Separate Plan
uncertainty: Plan currency-change constraints were not reviewed.

name: Mobile offline and stale sync
description: Downloaded plans can open offline; cloud-only plans need connectivity. Very stale device data is cleared and refreshed from the server instead of being synced back.
user_problem: Offline edits on an old device can conflict with current plan data.
benefit: Stale-data rejection protects the current server plan from outdated local state.
source_locator: Switching Between Multiple Plans; offline plan icons
uncertainty: Staleness threshold and local edit recovery steps are unspecified.

name: Mobile transaction workflow
description: Mobile apps support manual transaction entry, flags, schedules, and transaction search.
user_problem: Users need to capture and review transactions away from a desktop.
benefit: Mobile capture lets users record spending away from a desktop.
source_locator: How to Add a Transaction; Scheduled Transactions
uncertainty: Help reports platform-specific UI differences and staged Android updates.

name: API authentication and privacy
description: API uses HTTPS and bearer tokens; personal access tokens can be revoked and must be kept private. API terms prohibit exposing tokens or handling users' bank credentials.
user_problem: Financial data and access tokens must not leak through integrations.
benefit: Token-based access and explicit handling rules reduce credential exposure.
source_locator: Authentication; Personal Access Tokens; API Terms of Service
uncertainty: Token storage controls are the integration developer's responsibility.

name: Export is not plan restore
description: Plan export is a one-way download and cannot be re-imported to restore a YNAB plan; bulk photo export is also unavailable.
user_problem: A downloaded export may be mistaken for a complete backup or round-trip format.
benefit: Clear limits help users plan separate backup and migration procedures.
source_locator: FAQs; Can I export and re-import a YNAB plan; Can I export photos
uncertainty: The docs do not characterize exports as a full recovery backup.

name: Credit-card payment handling
description: Funded credit-card spending moves money from the spending category to the card-payment category; prior debt, interest, overspending, positive balances, and balance transfers can need manual assignment.
user_problem: Card purchases and payments can otherwise double-count spending or leave payment money short.
benefit: Separate payment funding makes the amount reserved for card bills visible.
source_locator: How Credit Cards Work; Scenarios When You Would Assign Directly
uncertainty: Edge-case formulas and imported payment matching deserve separate verification.

name: Preset focused views
description: Filter categories by funding, availability, snoozed or web overspending state.
user_problem: Large plans obscure action.
benefit: Focus on relevant category subsets.
uncertainty: Platform presets differ.

name: Custom focused views
description: Create, edit, reorder and delete personal category views.
user_problem: Fixed views may not match a routine.
benefit: Reuse relevant category subsets.
uncertainty: No authenticated custom view observed.

name: Category lifecycle
description: Create, rename, hide and unhide categories while retaining history.
user_problem: A changing household needs a manageable category list.
benefit: Keep history without everyday clutter.
uncertainty: Hidden money still exists.

name: Category deletion and reassignment
description: Deleting used categories requires reassignment of past activity and money.
user_problem: Deleting a category could orphan its history.
benefit: Preserve categorized financial totals.
uncertainty: Card payment categories cannot be deleted; history effects need comparison.

name: Category groups and order
description: Organize and reorder groups and their categories.
user_problem: Flat lists impede prioritization.
benefit: Keep a meaningful plan order.
source_locator: Reorder / Add a New Category Group
uncertainty: Group deletion must preserve activity.

name: Pinned categories
description: Pin selected categories for quick access.
user_problem: Frequent checks require repeated navigation.
benefit: Reach priorities quickly.
uncertainty: Documented mobile Home workflow.

name: Move category money
description: Move assigned cash between categories or Ready to Assign.
user_problem: Priorities change after initial funding.
benefit: Reprioritize without a bank transaction.
uncertainty: No movement between bank accounts.

name: Recent money-move history
description: Review moves and category-month assignment history.
user_problem: Changed availability is hard to explain.
benefit: Trace funding decisions.
uncertainty: Recent window 34 days; category history up to three prior months, current/future.

name: Snooze monthly target
description: Suppress the current-month request while retaining future target behavior.
user_problem: An exceptional month creates false alerts.
benefit: Acknowledge an intentional pause.
uncertainty: No bank payment or actual cash changes.

name: Plan reset
description: Redistribute current plan cash without archiving transaction history.
user_problem: Assignments may no longer match priorities.
benefit: Restart allocation from known cash.
uncertainty: Broad money move; not undertaken.

name: Fresh Start and archived plan
description: Create a new configured plan and retain the original.
user_problem: Restarting after a long gap is overwhelming.
benefit: Reuse setup and preserve the old ledger.
uncertainty: Not retrospective or a CSV restore; not performed.

name: Together plan sharing
description: Invite people with individual logins and selected shared plans.
user_problem: Households may coordinate decisions.
benefit: Share without sharing passwords.
uncertainty: Outside Budget single-user V1; manager visibility matters.

name: Undo and redo
description: Reverse recent actions with platform-specific scope.
user_problem: Mistakes need a recoverable path.
benefit: Correct accidental assignments or edits.
source_locator: How to Access Undo and Redo
uncertainty: Mobile money moves/assignments only; web history ends at refresh/logout.

name: Keyboard shortcuts and arithmetic
description: Navigate and edit using configurable shortcuts and arithmetic.
user_problem: Repeated mouse actions slow routine work.
benefit: Speed capture and corrections.
uncertainty: OS differences; reuse Budget strict parser.

name: Mobile Home priorities and future funding
description: Home summarizes priorities, monthly reflection and future assignments.
user_problem: Several time horizons compete for attention.
benefit: Separate immediate decisions from future funding.
uncertainty: Documented mobile layout; private settings not observed.

name: Plan affordability summary
description: The monthly summary displays target totals alongside expected income.
user_problem: Target needs and actual funds can be confused.
benefit: Distinguish planned funding needs from receipts.
source_locator: Plan > monthly summary > Cost to Be Me / Targets / Expected Income; YOBS-002
uncertainty: Display inspected; editing income and internal formulas not exercised.

name: Progress-bar display controls
description: The category table exposes Progress Bars On and Off controls.
user_problem: Dense category data can be difficult to scan.
benefit: Offer a visual progress representation.
uncertainty: Controls observed only; preference was not changed.

name: Category notes and target inspector
description: Selecting a category shows Notes, target detail, Edit Target and Snooze controls.
user_problem: Funding context can be separated from category decisions.
benefit: Keep supporting context beside the selected category.
uncertainty: Selection restored; no note/target/snooze action performed.

name: Plan format settings
description: Plan Settings exposes currency, placement, number and date-format controls.
user_problem: Formats must match the currency and locale.
benefit: Make displayed financial amounts interpretable.
uncertainty: Dialog inspected and cancelled without applying settings; permitted changes untested.
